title: Previous / Next (navigate.previous, navigate.next): a 1-tab pane steps the sidebar's workspaces; a 2-tab pane steps its own tabs and wraps inside the pane
preconditions: private scratch config (workspaces.newPlacement top, the default: a new workspace is listed first)
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with the keyboard
converted from scripts/cmux-next/rapid-switch-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-095.json links them

steps.note: the scenario of scripts/cmux-next/rapid-switch-e2e.py (kept): its default run, without --tab-rows
the script's setup: a terminal workspace (created/0 is its public id). A socket run without focus files it in the window without showing it
listed on top: the sidebar reads third-workspace, second-workspace, the launch workspace
the script's workspace.selectFirst: the sidebar's first workspace shows with the keyboard in its one terminal tab
script row '1-tab pane: Next steps the sidebar': the next workspace down shows
script row '1-tab pane: Previous steps back': the first workspace again
the script's newSurface: a second terminal tab in the shown pane
script row '2-tab pane: Next stays in the pane': the pane's other tab has the keyboard
script row '2-tab pane: Next wraps inside the pane': the second press comes back to the first tab

invariants: layout/screens/0/workspace is third-workspace's created/0 at first, previous, two-tabs and wrapped, and second-workspace's at next (the waits check the steps)
layout/screens/0/workspace at next-tab and next-tab-wraps equals the one at two-tabs: Next in a 2-tab pane never leaves the pane's workspace
focus/windows/0/model/resolvedTab at next-tab differs from the one at two-tabs, and at next-tab-wraps equals it: Next wraps inside the pane
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the script's --tab-rows leg (Show Tabs Under Workspaces on, Next stops at each tab row): it reads the sidebar's rows and selection (debug.sidebar_rows), and the sidebar facet has no provider yet (p15-oracle-036)
a top item (Home, App Store) as the selection: the sidebar facet's (p15-oracle-036)
